beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then read the constitutional proposals for making complexity legible and correction usable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book gives readers a way to investigate harm without requiring a person to hate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its deeper question concerns which connections an institution must reveal and which decisions someone can stop.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to distinguish a process that explains itself from one that can provide a remedy.
